meta.name: ai-content-research-writer
meta.description: 资料整理助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“这份材料重点是什么”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成内容诊断、优化建议、执行清单。

copy.tagline: 快速提取材料重点并生成内容优化方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需从大量资料中提炼要点并形成可执行建议
copy.tagline_en: Extract key points from materials and generate actionable content insights
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to distill key points from large amounts of material and form actionable suggestions

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成资料整理助手。当你提供内容目标、受众、参考链接或文本时，它会分析材料，输出内容诊断、优化建议和执行清单。
howto.when: 当你提出“这份材料重点是什么”这类问题，或需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这篇公众号文章的重点是什么。
say.note: Claude 会输出内容诊断和优化建议。

say.text: 我有一份产品介绍草稿，目标受众是中小企业主，请给出优化建议。
say.note: Claude 会结合受众生成执行清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a content research writer. When you provide goals, audience, reference links or text, it analyzes materials and outputs content diagnosis, optimization suggestions, and action checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "What are the key points of this material?" or need to quickly break down goals, identify priorities, and form actionable results.

say_en.text: Analyze the key points of this WeChat article.
say_en.note: Claude will output diagnosis and suggestions.

say_en.text: I have a product draft for SME owners, give optimization tips.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an action checklist.
